title: embedded-dev hardware-in-the-loop diagnostic report
description: Contract written by `embedded_dev.py hil` after every build -> flash -> monitor attempt. The same keys drive the ai_repair_prompt, so a failure can be repaired from evidence instead of guesses.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC time of the attempt

signature.description: sha256[:16] of status + fault bits + serial tail; equal signatures mean the same failure

ai_repair_prompt.description: self-contained repair prompt: status, evidence, repeated-failure warning and next actions

source_unchanged.description: true only when the same signature repeats and the git head/working tree did not change

fault_diagnostics.description: decode_fault() output (CFSR/HFSR bits, BFAR/MMFAR, PC/LR) or null

serial_log_tail.description: last 2000 characters captured from the target UART
